name: useConfirmDanger
usage: Irreversible actions such as deleting, clearing data, transferring ownership or disbanding a team

types.name: ConfirmDangerOptions
types.summary: Options of a danger confirmation: what is passed to the `confirm` function returned by useConfirmDanger.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the dialog, naming the action, such as "Delete project".

fields.name: description
fields.description: The consequences: what is deleted and whether it can be restored.

fields.name: confirmText
fields.description:
Text the user must type before "Confirm" is enabled, usually the name of the object (compared exactly,
case-sensitive). The dialog asks for it itself (`Type "…" to confirm`), so do not repeat that in the
`description`. Without it, a click on "Confirm" is enough.

fields.name: okText
fields.description: Text of the confirm button, such as "Delete"; the built-in "Confirm" text of the current locale by default.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Irreversible actions can only be confirmed after typing the name.
